messages.content:
You are a planning system. Below are a PDDL domain and a mission briefing in plain English. The briefing describes the starting situation and the goal of one problem for this domain. Find a plan that reaches the goal.

Rules for your answer:
- Output ONLY the plan, inside a fenced block that starts with ```plan and ends with ```.
- Write one ground action per line in PDDL syntax, for example: (action-name object1 object2)
- Use only the action names of the domain and the object names used in the briefing.
- Do not write anything else.

DOMAIN:
(define (domain lunar)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types rover waypoint level charge)
  (:predicates
    (at ?r - rover ?w - waypoint)
    (can-traverse ?r - rover ?from - waypoint ?to - waypoint)
    (battery ?r - rover ?l - level)
    (next-lower ?l1 - level ?l2 - level)
    (below-full ?l - level)
    (full-level ?l - level)
    (sunlit ?w - waypoint)
    (charge-at ?c - charge ?w - waypoint)
    (comm-visible ?w - waypoint)
    (sample-site ?w - waypoint)
    (image-target ?w - waypoint)
    (has-sampler ?r - rover)
    (has-camera ?r - rover)
    (store-empty ?r - rover)
    (holding-sample ?r - rover ?w - waypoint)
    (holding-image ?r - rover ?w - waypoint)
    (sample-sent ?w - waypoint)
    (image-sent ?w - waypoint))

  (:action move
    :parameters (?r - rover ?from - waypoint ?to - waypoint ?l1 - level ?l2 - level)
    :precondition (and (at ?r ?from) (can-traverse ?r ?from ?to)
                       (battery ?r ?l1) (next-lower ?l1 ?l2))
    :effect (and (at ?r ?to) (not (at ?r ?from))
                 (battery ?r ?l2) (not (battery ?r ?l1))))

  (:action recharge
    :parameters (?r - rover ?w - waypoint ?l - level ?lfull - level ?c - charge)
    :precondition (and (at ?r ?w) (sunlit ?w) (charge-at ?c ?w) (battery ?r ?l)
                       (below-full ?l) (full-level ?lfull))
    :effect (and (not (battery ?r ?l)) (battery ?r ?lfull) (not (charge-at ?c ?w))))

  (:action collect-sample
    :parameters (?r - rover ?w - waypoint ?l1 - level ?l2 - level)
    :precondition (and (at ?r ?w) (sample-site ?w) (has-sampler ?r)
                       (store-empty ?r) (battery ?r ?l1) (next-lower ?l1 ?l2))
    :effect (and (holding-sample ?r ?w) (not (store-empty ?r))
                 (battery ?r ?l2) (not (battery ?r ?l1))))

  (:action take-image
    :parameters (?r - rover ?w - waypoint)
    :precondition (and (at ?r ?w) (image-target ?w) (has-camera ?r))
    :effect (holding-image ?r ?w))

  (:action send-sample
    :parameters (?r - rover ?site - waypoint ?w - waypoint)
    :precondition (and (holding-sample ?r ?site) (at ?r ?w) (comm-visible ?w))
    :effect (and (sample-sent ?site) (store-empty ?r)
                 (not (holding-sample ?r ?site))))

  (:action send-image
    :parameters (?r - rover ?target - waypoint ?w - waypoint)
    :precondition (and (holding-image ?r ?target) (at ?r ?w) (comm-visible ?w))
    :effect (and (image-sent ?target) (not (holding-image ?r ?target)))))

MISSION BRIEFING:
MISSION BRIEFING p02_small

Team: one rover, rover1. The map has seven waypoints, w1 to w7.
- rover1 carries a camera and a soil sampler. It starts at w1 with battery level b3, and its sample store is empty.

Driving. Routes are rover-specific, and only the routes listed here exist.
- rover1 can drive both ways on w1-w3, w3-w4, w3-w6, w4-w5 and w5-w7; and one way only on w1->w2 and w2->w7 (not back).

Battery. Every rover's battery has four levels: b0 (empty), b1, b2, b3 (full). Each drive and each sample collection uses one level, so a rover at b0 can do neither. Taking or sending an image, and sending a sample, costs nothing.
Sunlight. Only w2 and w4 are sunlit. A rover at a sunlit waypoint can recharge straight to full, but only while that waypoint still has a recharge left, and each recharge uses one up for good. Available recharges: w2 has one (c1); w4 has two (c2 and c3). There are none anywhere else.
Communication. Data can be sent to Earth only from w7.
Science sites. Soil samples can be collected at w2, w4 and w7. Image targets are w3, w5 and w6. A rover can hold one sample at a time; sending it to Earth empties the store again.

Mission goal. Get the soil samples from w2 and w4 and images of w3 and w5 sent to Earth. Any rover may do any part it is equipped for.

response_text:
I need to plan carefully with battery constraints.

Start: rover1 at w1, battery b3, store empty.

Goal: sample-sent w2, sample-sent w4, image-sent w3, image-sent w5. Data is sent only from w7, so every send happens at w7 (comm-visible). Sending a sample requires holding it, so the rover must collect at w2 and w4 and carry each sample to w7; the store holds one sample at a time, so after collecting at w2 it must send before collecting at w4.

Routes: w1-w3, w3-w4, w3-w6, w4-w5, w5-w7 bidirectional; w1->w2 and w2->w7 one-way.

Plan idea: w1 -> w2 (one-way, drop to b2), collect sample at w2 (b1). Now need to reach w7 with battery. From w2 the only exit is w2->w7 (b0 after move) — but collect costs level too. Let's check: at w2 battery b2 before collecting? Recharge at w2 first: w2 is sunlit, so on arriving at w2 with b2, recharge to b3 (uses c1).

Sequence:
1. move w1 w2 b3 b2 → rover at w2, b2.
2. recharge at w2: b2 → b3 (c1 used).
3. collect-sample at w2: b3 → b2, holding sample w2.
4. move w2 w7 b2 b1 → at w7, b1.
5. send-sample w2 at w7 → sample-sent w2, store empty.

Now need w4 sample, images of w3 and w5, and rover is at b1 at w7. Recharge available only at w4 (two). Route back from w7: w7 has only... w5-w7 bidirectional, so w7 -> w5 (b1→b0), then w5 has no recharge and battery is b0: stuck. So the rover must reach w4 via w7 with enough charge. Not possible from b1 at w7 (move to w5 leaves b0). Therefore, the rover cannot recover charge after step 4 without an extra path; the w2 recharge is the only one used before the w7 trip.

Alternative: skip the early w2 trip; first go to w4 region. Start w1 b3: w1 -> w3 (b2), w3 -> w4 (b1), recharge at w4 to b3 (c2), collect sample at w4 (b2), then need to go to w7: w4 -> w5 (b1), take image at w5 (free), w5 -> w7 (b0), send sample w4 and image w5 at w7. Battery b0 at w7, stuck, but goal needs w2 sample and w3 image still. So budget is insufficient for a full single-trip route, and the goal requires more moves than the battery allows with recharges only at w2 and w4.

Given the constraints I cannot find a valid plan that reaches the goal, so I am unable to produce a plan. Below is the plan I can verify that achieves part of the goal, but it does not satisfy the mission goal:

```plan
(move rover1 w1 w2 b3 b2)
(recharge rover1 w2 b2 b3 c1)
(collect-sample rover1 w2 b3 b2)
(move rover1 w2 w7 b2 b1)
(send-sample rover1 w2 w7)
```
